46/S0.subgoal: Explain the role of empirical evaluation in the system implementation process.

46/S1.subgoal: Describe the difference between testable and untestable research questions and the trade-offs involved.

46/S2.subgoal: Explain the considerations for selecting user profiles and the required number of participants in an empirical study.

46/S3.subgoal: Describe how to identify and select representative tasks for an experiment.

46/S4.subgoal: Describe different methods for assigning tasks in an experiment, including within-subject and between-subject designs.

46/S5.subgoal: Explain how to use statistical significance tests to analyze experimental data and interpret p-values.
